physical_state_in: Suspended sediment and dissolved nutrients from 801463 km² catchment
physical_state_out: Sediment and nutrient flux at delta apex after Iron Gate dam cascade
primary_transformation: Dam trapping and agricultural loading modify the geomorphic and nutrient subsidy of the delta
measurable_output: Suspended sediment concentration at delta apex (mg/L); nutrient load (t/yr)
D_parameters: Historical sediment budget; dam trapping efficiency; upstream erosion rates; nutrient loading from agriculture
C_parameters: Current suspended sediment flux; dissolved nutrient concentrations; turbidity at delta apex
notes: Iron Gate I/II dams trap 57% of historical sediment; current load 34 Mt/yr vs. historical 80 Mt/yr

physical_state_in: River discharge pulses from three distributaries (Chilia/Sulina/Sfantu Gheorghe)
physical_state_out: Seasonal inundation patterns; water residence times; salinity gradient at Black Sea margin
primary_transformation: Discharge translated into wetland inundation area and water depth — the hydrological template for all habitats
measurable_output: Inundation area (km²/season); discharge at distributary mouths (m³/s)
D_parameters: River discharge regulation by upstream dams; seasonal flood pulse timing; salinity gradient management
C_parameters: Wetland inundation extent; water residence time in lakes; flood pulse amplitude and frequency
notes: Mean annual discharge 6500 m³/s at Ceatal Izmail; spring flood pulse peak ~15800 m³/s; DDBRA 22-station network

physical_state_in: Inundated floodplain with variable water depths (0.2-3.5 m) and nutrient concentrations
physical_state_out: Structural mosaic of reed beds / shallow lakes / floating islands / channels / riparian forest / sand dunes
primary_transformation: Hydrological and biogeochemical processes convert inputs into differentiated habitat structures
measurable_output: Habitat type area (ha) by class; vegetation diversity index (Shannon H')
D_parameters: Sediment supply for land-building; nutrient input controlling productivity; hydrological regime defining habitat boundaries
C_parameters: Reed bed coverage (178000 ha); shallow lake area (83500 ha); habitat diversity index (Shannon H' = 2.31)
notes: Largest continuous Phragmites australis stand in Europe; Copernicus/ESA 10m mapping available; plaur floating islands 28000 ha

physical_state_in: Habitat mosaic providing nesting sites and food resources for birds / fish / mammals
physical_state_out: Population-level indicators: breeding pair counts; juvenile recruitment; fish biomass; mammal occupancy
primary_transformation: Ecosystem conditions translate habitat into species populations through food web and breeding dynamics
measurable_output: Breeding pairs of Dalmatian pelican (key indicator); fish species richness index; mammal occupancy
D_parameters: Habitat carrying capacity; prey availability; breeding site protection; absence of invasive species; low disturbance
C_parameters: Dalmatian pelican 3700 pairs; white pelican 4200 pairs; fish species richness 45 spp.; otter occupancy 68% of sites
notes: Birds excellently monitored (SOR); fish and mammals partial; sturgeon functionally absent post-dam; 14 invasive species

physical_state_in: Species populations and ecosystem processes operating within habitat mosaic
physical_state_out: Delivered services: gene pool maintenance / fisheries nursery / cultural value / ecotourism / carbon sequestration
primary_transformation: Species populations and ecosystem processes translate into quantifiable services for human beneficiaries
measurable_output: Biodiversity service composite index; ecotourism visitor-days/yr; reed carbon stock (t CO2)
D_parameters: Conservation status targets (Habitats Directive); WFD ecological status; Ramsar ecological character maintenance
C_parameters: 80000 ecotourism visitors/yr; 28 million EUR ecotourism revenue; 11 Mt CO2 reed carbon stock; 28% habitats in favourable status
notes: Only 28% Habitats Directive habitats in favourable status (Art.17 2019); 40% WFD good ecological status; existence value largely unmonetized
